data.description:
## Context / Problem
Backtests over the 7-day population (153 tickets; 104 passed-plan FP set, 55 blocked-plan hit set) and a 200-ticket extended set support two deterministic floor additions. (R1) verification-presence: 1-4/104 marginal FPs, and all 4 hits on blocked plans overlapped the real blocking findings. (R2) the P6 vague lexicon matches `\bword` with no trailing boundary (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py:458-477), so `clean` fires on "cleanly"/"lint clean"; the fixed rule measured 0 FPs across 304 passed plans (rule-of-three 95% bound ~1.0%). Operator approved both for blocking.

## Approach
(R1) New blocking DET check: a leaf plan must have >= 1 `- [ ]` AC item containing a backtick command, test reference, or verification phrase, OR a `## Testing`/`## Verification` section. (R2) Rewrite the lexicon match: both boundaries (`\bword\b`), strip inline code spans before matching, scope to AC item lines via det_operator_attested.ac_item_lines, drop `clean` (all 12 corpus firings were technical idiom), keep `etc.` with a code-span-proximity exemption (within 30 chars), keep the remaining terms unchanged; promote the fixed check to blocking. Alternative rejected: spec-by-example/riskiest-assumption floors — backtests showed no discrimination between good and blocked plans (76%/71% and 86%/80% fire rates).

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, tests/llm/test_det_floor_clarity.py, docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md (regenerated with the documented command).

## Testing
Unit: a plan whose ACs carry no verify hook and no Testing section blocks under R1; a plan with one backticked-command AC passes; "lint clean"/"cleanly" ACs pass R2; a bare vague term ("works properly") in an AC line blocks; the same term inside a code span passes; `etc.` adjacent to a code span passes, bare `etc.` blocks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] R1 blocks a leaf plan with no verification hook in any AC and no Testing/Verification section (checked: unit test).
- [ ] R1 passes when >= 1 AC carries a backtick command/test reference or a Testing section exists (checked: unit test).
- [ ] The fixed lexicon produces zero matches on the 16 previously false-positive AC fixtures taken from the backtest (checked: parameterized unit test reproducing those AC lines).
- [ ] `clean` is removed from the lexicon and `etc.` respects the code-span exemption (checked: unit tests).
- [ ] The criteria guide is regenerated and mentions both rules (checked: regen command output committed; guide text asserts).
data.title: Clarity floor: blocking verification-presence check and boundary-fixed vague lexicon
